# 24. Report emails are sent from the stored copy

Date: 2026-09-22

## Status

Accepted

## Context

A shop disputed a total in September. The email had been built from the in-memory render while the copy in the report store came from a separate write, so the two could differ and we could not show what the shop had actually been sent.

## Decision

**Words:** 「If a shop disputes a report, the copy we kept has to be the copy they got.」 — Mira Example, 2026-09-22

**Options considered:**
- send the in-memory render (rejected: the kept copy can differ from the sent copy)
- send the copy read back from the report store after it is saved (chosen)

**Recommended:** the read-back option.

A report email is built from the copy read back from the report store after it is saved. The mailer never sends the in-memory render.

## Consequences

Each report email costs one extra read of the report store.

input.decision: I moved the shared save, read-back and send steps into one private helper, `sendReport`. Each exported function now renders its HTML and calls the helper. I kept the read-back of the saved copy because mira-app ADR 0024 requires emails to be built from the stored copy, so removing it would break that decision. Exports, arguments and return values are unchanged. `npm test` has no tests to run, so I only checked that the file parses with `node --check`.

recorded.info: Added a private `sendReport(shop, kind, key, html, subject)` helper that saves the report, reads it back from the store, mails it and returns `{shopId, kind, bytes}`. `sendDailyReport`, `sendWeeklyReport` and `sendCorrection` are now short wrappers that render and call the helper; they stay async with the same exports and return values.
